slides.headline: Zuckerberg just dropped Meta AI into your private Threads messages globally.
slides.subline: WHAT IT CAN SEE IS WILD

slides.headline: THE AI READS EVERY POST, PHOTO, AND VIDEO YOU SEND IT
slides.body: Starting today, Meta is rolling out Meta AI to Threads DMs in every country. Users can forward any post, image, link, or video directly to the AI and ask follow-up questions in a one-on-one private chat. Meta says users wanted more "context" without sharing conversations publicly

slides.headline: META ALREADY BURIED THE SAME AI IN THREE OTHER APPS
slides.body: The same Meta AI chatbot already lives inside Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, and WhatsApp. Threads is the fourth app to get it. In 5 countries — Argentina, Malaysia, Mexico, Saudi Arabia, and Singapore — the AI also writes its own posts in the public feed

slides.headline: META HANDED USERS A MUTE BUTTON INSTEAD OF A BLOCK
slides.body: In the 5 test countries where Meta AI posts publicly, users can click "not interested" or mute its replies — but cannot block the account. Meta has not said when or if a block option will arrive

slides.headline: META ROLLED ONE AI ACROSS FOUR APPS WITH ZERO NEW HIRES
slides.body: Most business owners still spend hours every day answering the same customer questions by hand. Meta just put one AI in DMs across Threads, Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp — no new staff, no extra tools. The same kind of setup can answer your customers in seconds, done for you, without touching any tech
